authority: Architecture v1 + SMX-042 selected semantic transaction DAG/checkpoint substrate

invariants.expected: Exact TransactionId binds actor plus positive sequence; replay is idempotent and collision is fatal.
Missing causal ancestors remain pending and cannot materialize authored state.
Offline disjoint semantic edits reunite without silently discarding either edit.
Concurrent same-locus edits remain explicit complete alternatives rather than last-write-wins guesses.
Definition conflict loci are scoped by stable DefinitionId, preserving R-018-01.
Thing tombstones remove-win over concurrent new incident Connections, preserving R-018-02.
Whole-result canonical validation precedes publication after synchronization convergence, preserving R-018-03.
Tombstoning a Thing tombstones incident Connections and Relationships, preserving R-018-04.
Stale permission-epoch work is recoverable history but never authorized active state.
Unsupported history schema is quarantined rather than guessed or partially migrated.
A transaction base must be an exact locally-known canonical revision and causally bind its producing transaction.
SQLite WAL plus synchronous FULL publishes receipt, payload, conflicts and head atomically.
Compaction requires an explicit non-regressing causal-stability frontier.
Stable ordinary/resolution payload may retire while exact receipts survive for replay/collision detection.
Tombstone, conflict, quarantine and protected-alternative history remains retained through compaction.
Selective undo is conservative: only retained current-leaf history can be inverted as a new semantic transaction.
Conflict resolution is itself a validated semantic transaction and marks alternatives resolved only at commit.
Relay authentication binds exact transaction bytes to principal; authentication is not semantic edit authority.
Relay/store copies never directly replace the local canonical collaboration head.
Presence, cursor and selection state is transient and absent after reopen.
Stable AssetId conflicts retain complete protected revisions, never mixed fields.
Protected source identity, exact metadata, audio/media semantics, provenance, licence/attribution and derivation lineage remain atomic.
Transaction, parent, conflict and project snapshot dimensions are independently bounded.
Runtime multiplayer/session/transport identities are not collaboration semantic identity.

protected_asset_fields: source digest and logical source identity
